content: {"praised": ["Fun action with plenty of guns and slow‑motion sequences.", "Homage to fans with strong fan service and redemption themes.", "Engaging characters, humor, and camaraderie between MacManus brothers.", "Lower budget yet still delivers solid storytelling and pacing.", "Visually appealing with graceful footage and good music."], "criticized": ["Story feels like forced copy of first film, lacking originality.", "Dialogue and acting are poor, with atrocious performances.", "Plot holes and contrivances undermine narrative.", "Over‑the‑top camerawork adds nothing to story.", "Characters lose their righteous path, becoming less compelling."]}
